notes: New: AI keys. You can now add several AI keys, give each a name (like "Gemini – project 2"), switch each one on or off, put them in order, and tap Test on any key. Open Settings → Brain (AI model) → AI keys. Your current Gemini key is already there as "Gemini (main)". Your old second provider is there too as "Second provider", switched off. If a key hits Google's free limit, is wrong, or its service is down, the assistant moves to the next active key by itself, for the same message. A key that hit the daily limit rests until it resets (about 3 AM your time) and the screen shows "resting until …". Test shows ✓ Works or a clear reason, and lists the models that key can use: tap one to choose it. For Groq, pick Type "Groq" and the base URL and model fill in for you. Voice notes and PDFs still need a Gemini key; if only Groq is free, you get a short note that only your words were passed on. Switches are written to the Activity log. Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again.
